title: Sections of smooth algebras modulo an ideal lift over an etale neighbourhood
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $J\subseteq A$ an ideal, $\pi:A\to A/J$ the quotient map, $B$ an $A$-algebra with $\operatorname{Spec}B\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], and $\sigma:B\to A/J$ a homomorphism of $A$-algebras. Then there are a ring map $A\to A'$ with $\operatorname{Spec}A'\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ etale [def-weil-etale-morphism] such that the induced map $\alpha:A/J\to A'/JA'$ is an isomorphism, and a homomorphism of $A$-algebras $\tilde\sigma:B\to A'$ lifting $\sigma$: $q\circ\tilde\sigma=\alpha\circ\sigma$, where $q:A'\to A'/JA'$ is the quotient map.

source.place: More on Algebra, Lemma Tag 07M7 (lemma-lift-section-smooth-morphism, line 2139) and its proof (Algebra lemma-application-NL-smooth, lemma-lift-projective-module, lemma-symmetric-algebra-smooth, Algebra lemma-exact-sequence-NL, lemma-NAK, ...); 'smooth A-algebra' there is a smooth ring map, equivalently Spec B -> Spec A smooth (Morphisms, Lemma 01V6, lemma-smooth-characterize)

proof.text: Apply exists_etale_neighbourhoods_of_smooth_section to obtain E,jE,tauE with tauE o jE=sigma and etale principal neighbourhoods at every prime containing ker tauE.
Apply exists_etale_localization_of_prime_mem to E and ker tauE. Obtain h invertible modulo the kernel and C=E_h etale over A.
Map the unit h modulo ker tauE through RingHom.kerLift tauE. Extend tauE to tau:C -> A/J by IsLocalization.Away.liftAlgHom, and set j=(E -> C) o jE. The formula for the lift on E gives tau o j=sigma.
Apply the quotient cutout theorem to C,tau to obtain g and t:D/JD -> A/J for D=C_g, with t(q(c/1))=tau(c).

Principal localization is etale, and compose with A -> C to get A -> D etale. Take alpha=t inverse and tilde sigma=(C -> D) o j. For b in B, apply the injective t to both sides of the requested equation; the cutout formula makes its left side tau(j(b))=sigma(b), while t(alpha(sigma(b)))=sigma(b).

Ten steps along the proof of 07M7, eleven new nodes: a definition node for smooth ring maps via the naive cotangent complex (07BN/00T2; Mathlib leaf Algebra.Smooth, Smooth/Basic.lean:540, with H1Cotangent for H_1(NL)), the identification lem-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map-iff-smooth-affine (01V6+02H6, unsplit; the first node connecting def-sbc-smooth-morphisms with smooth ring maps), and the lemmas of the proof: base change and composition of smooth maps (00T4/00TD; Mathlib leaf, lines 573/568 verified), the conormal sequence 06A9, lifting projective modules along an etale neighbourhood 07M5, Sym of a finite projective module is smooth 07M6, base change of differentials 00RV (leaf, Kaehler/TensorProduct.lean:189), the Jacobi-Zariski sequence 00S2 for a quotient, surjective endomorphisms of finite modules 05G8 (leaf, OrzechProperty.lean:108 with CommRing.orzechProperty), etale near a prime from the vanishing of NL 07BU, and the localization lemma 07M0. The three agent-written parts (survival of the conormal module under A -> A_1 via base change of differentials, the computation for B (x) Sym(K), the final check) read correctly. theorem exists_etale_lift_of_smooth
    (A B : Type u) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    (J : Ideal A) (σ : B →ₐ[A] A ⧸ J)
    (hB : Smooth (Scheme.Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B)).op)) :
    ∃ (A' : CommAlgCat.{u} A),
      Etale (Scheme.Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A A')).op) ∧
      ∃ (α : A ⧸ J →ₐ[A]
          A' ⧸ (J.map (algebraMap A A'))),
        Function.Bijective α ∧
        ∃ (tildeσ : B →ₐ[A] A'),
          Ideal.Quotient.mk (J.map (algebraMap A A')) ∘ tildeσ =
            α.toRingHom ∘ σ.toRingHom
